display.purpose: Page titles, set in the route-board face.

shadows.name: button-lip

shadows.name: plate-ring
shadows.purpose: The painted outline on area plates and mood chips.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Only for the floating compare tray and tour card.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen: a yellow route plate with a pressed lip.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: var(--plate, #ffd000); color: var(--board, #141414); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 22px 15px; min-height: 48px; font-family: 'Saira Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--plate-edge, #a88800); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #ffdc40; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--plate-edge, #a88800); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #141414; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Second choice beside a primary: white plate, outline, no lip.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #fff; color: #141414; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 48px; font-family: 'Saira Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #b9b9b0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #e8e8e2; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #3a3a36; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #141414; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mood Plate
components.description: Filter chip as a painted plate; selected turns route yellow.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #fff; color: #141414; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 12px; min-height: 40px; font-family: 'Saira Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #141414; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #fff3b0; } .ds-chip.on { background: #ffd000; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #141414; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destination Blind
components.description: The search: a board-black field with route-yellow lettering.
components.html: <input class="ds-blind" placeholder="Where to tonight?" aria-label="Ask Fyndo">
components.css: .ds-blind { background: #141414; color: #ffd000; border: 2px solid #141414; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: 'Saira Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; width: 100%; } .ds-blind::placeholder { color: #d9b400; } .ds-blind:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffd000; }

components.name: Area Plate
components.description: Where a place is, with its open (green) or closed (chilli) mark always in the first cell.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 4px 9px 3px; border-radius: 5px; background: #ffd000; color: #141414; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #141414; font-family: 'Saira Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #c8381f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #141414; } .ds-dot.open { background: #13804a; }

components.name: Place Card
components.description: Photo first, area plate on the photo, name left and the per-person price as a route numeral right.
components.html:

600–1,000LKR per person
components.css: .ds-card { width: 320px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d8d8d0; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; } .ds-card-ph { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#7a4a22,#c4843a 60%,#efc77f); } .ds-card-ph .ds-plate { position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 4px 9px 3px; border-radius: 5px; background: #ffd000; color: #141414; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #141414; font: 800 18px/1.05 'Saira Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-card-ph .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #13804a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #141414; } .ds-card-b { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 12px 14px; } .ds-name { font-size: 17px; color: #141414; } .ds-sub { font-size: 13px; color: #5f5f58; margin-top: 3px; } .ds-price { text-align: right; } .ds-price b { display: block; font: 800 30px/.9 'Saira Condensed', sans-serif; color: #141414; } .ds-price span { font-size: 11px; color: #5f5f58; }

components.name: Header Band
components.description: The green livery band; the current page is a yellow plate.
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 16px 12px; background: #11593a; border-bottom: 1px solid #0b3f29; color: #fff; } .ds-brand { font: 800 30px/1 'Saira Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-band nav { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-band a { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 18px 'Saira Condensed', sans-serif; color: #d8eee3; cursor: pointer; } .ds-band a:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,.16); color: #fff; } .ds-band a.on { background: #ffd000; color: #141414; }

narrative.overview: Fyndo borrows the working signage of Colombo's buses: the livery band (painted tea-estate green), the yellow route board, the black destination blind. Every place reads like a stop on that board: its area on a yellow plate, its per-person price set as the route number. The world lends four things only, type, palette, density and one signature move; the layout, navigation and controls stay the ordinary ones people already know from apps. The ground is a cool board-white, never cream. Green owns the shell; red is kept for errors and "closed" only. Yellow on black is reserved for the things that orient you or act: area plates, the search blind, the selected plate and the one primary action. Hierarchy comes from scale, not from many sizes: huge condensed numerals for prices and route numbers, small plain labels for everything else.
keyCharacteristics: Green livery band at the top on every screen; the active page is a yellow plate in it (desktop) or a green marker in the bottom bar (phone).
Yellow area plates with a 2px board-black ring, carrying the open/closed mark in their first cell.
Prices as route-board numerals in Saira Condensed 800, with "LKR per person" beneath.
The planner drawn as a route: a green line with numbered yellow stop plates.
Atkinson Hyperlegible for all reading text: built for low vision, second-language readers and outdoor light.

rules.name: The Shell Green Rule
rules.body: Green is the bus, not the cargo: it lives in the header band, the active nav marker and the route line, never as a card fill or a text colour for content. Red only ever means a problem or "closed".

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears only where it orients or acts: an area plate, the search blind, a selected plate, the primary button. A screen with yellow decoration has lost its signage.

rules.name: The Scale Rule
rules.body: Rank by scale contrast: a price or route number is huge, its label is small, and there is no in-between size competing with them.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Plates, buttons and heads are sentence case; no tracked capitals.

rules.name: The Painted Board Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat like painted signage; anything that lifts does so because it floats over content or responds to a press.

dos: Do keep green to the shell (header band, active nav marker, route line, saved state) and red to problems and "closed".
Do put area and price on every place surface as a plate and a route numeral.
Do keep the open/closed mark inside the area plate, in the same place on every card.
Do use Atkinson Hyperlegible for anything longer than a label.
donts: Don't use a cream or warm paper ground; the ground is cool board-white (#f2f2ee).
Don't add yellow as decoration; it marks plates, the search blind, selection and the primary action only.
Don't set prices or names in tracked capitals, or add labels above headings.
Don't turn the bus world into a costume: no fake route numbers, ticket stubs or destination-blind animations on working screens.
